legend: There is expansion of the basal cell layer, with mild nuclear pleomorphism.
There is full-thickness dysplasia, with severe nuclear pleomorphism.

A On low-magnification endoscopy with narrow-band imaging, the lesion appears as a brownish area about 10 mm in size on the front left wall, 30 cm from the incisors. B On high-magnification endoscopy with narrow-band imaging, the intrapapillary capillary loops are mildly irregular and the mucosa between them is brightly coloured. C On white-light endoscopy, the lesion appears as a flat, slightly depressed lesion with mild redness. D On Lugol’s chromoendoscopy, the lesion is positive for the pink-colour sign – it is well demarcated and unstained.
